{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sauces|Sauces]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian Cuisine]]

{{decameron}}

== Ingredients ==
*2 spoonfuls burnt [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 spoonful [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
*[[Cookbook:Stock|Stock]]
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Espagnole Sauce|Espagnole sauce]] (No. 1)
*A few stoned [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
*A few [[Cookbook:Pine Nut|pine nuts]] or slivered [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]

== Procedure ==
#Mix burnt sugar with vinegar, and dilute with a little stock.
#Add Espagnole sauce, raisins, and pine nuts.
#Keep this hot in a [[Cookbook:Bain-Marie|bain-marie]], and serve with cutlets, calf's head or feet or tongue.
